record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, untie the historical-input and candidate-output item embeddings, retaining width 64 and dot-product scoring. Initialize the output table as a copy of the input table, then train both jointly within each category's single NextItNet model. Separate roles may reduce conflict between frequency-attenuated history encoding and target discrimination. Keep features, causal blocks, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged; update checkpoint loading and the predictor writer consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Untie input and output item embeddings across all four category models, initializing the output table from the input table. Both tables train jointly within each single NextItNet model. Preserve embedding width, causal backbone, features, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer; record and verify embedding compatibility in the predictor writer.
